blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon on Thursday vowed to crack down on shipping companies that violate maritime safety rules following the Sept. 9 ferry fire in Palawan that killed 77 people. Dizon said he would discuss stricter enforcement measures with key officials of the Department of Transportation (DOTr) and its attached agencies during his first executive committee meeting. The meeting will include Philippine Ports Authority General Manager Jay Santiago, Maritime Industry Authority Executive Director Samuel Batalla and Philippine Coast Guard Commandant Vice Admiral Rommel Supangan.
